name: HealthTrack
description: Self-hosted personal health tracker. Track medications, conditions, allergies, labs, vitals, procedures, vaccines, appointments and notes for yourself and your dependents — all data stays in a single SQLite database and uploads folder under /data on your server. No cloud services required. The first registered user becomes the instance admin; after that, registration is invite-only by default (create single-use invite links under Settings, or set SIGNUPS_ENABLED to true to open registration). Optional integrations (each enabled only when its keys are set): Anthropic API key for AI health summaries, natural-language queries and lab/vaccine PDF parsing; Google OAuth for "Sign in with Google"; Oura for ring data sync. Back up /data to back up everything.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: All application state: SQLite database (healthtrack.db), uploaded lab PDFs (uploads/) and auto-generated secrets (keys/). Back up this folder to back up everything.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the HealthTrack web interface. If another container already uses 3000 (Mealie, Grafana, etc.), change this to a free port and update APP_URL to match — the container always listens on 3000 internally.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: The URL users browse to — required for login/auth callbacks to work. Use your server's address and the mapped port, e.g. http://YOUR_SERVER_IP:3000 (or your reverse-proxy HTTPS URL if you use one).

variables.name: SIGNUPS_ENABLED
variables.description: Registration policy. Leave EMPTY (recommended): the first account registers freely and becomes admin, then new accounts require a single-use invite link (Settings > Invites). Set to true to open registration to anyone, or false to close it completely.

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Anthropic API key — enables AI features: health summaries, natural-language health queries, medication interaction checks and lab/vaccine PDF parsing. AI features are hidden when unset.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. Google OAuth client ID — enables the 'Sign in with Google' button. REQUIRES serving over HTTPS on a real hostname (reverse proxy or tunnel): Google rejects http:// and LAN-IP redirect URIs, so this will NOT work on a bare 192.168.x.x address. In the Google Cloud Console, add this authorized redirect URI: APP_URL/api/auth/callback/google (email/password login works without any of this).

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Google OAuth client secret (pairs with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).

variables.name: OURA_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. Oura OAuth client ID — enables Oura Ring sync (sleep, heart rate, activity). In the Oura developer portal, set the redirect URI to: APP_URL/api/oura/callback

variables.name: OURA_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Oura OAuth client secret (pairs with OURA_CLIENT_ID).

variables.name: AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Advanced. Session signing secret. Leave empty — one is auto-generated into /data/keys on first start. Set only if you want to manage it yourself.

variables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Advanced. Key used to encrypt stored OAuth tokens (Oura). Leave empty — one is auto-generated into /data/keys on first start. Set only if you want to manage it yourself.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns files under /data (Unraid default: 99 / nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns files under /data (Unraid default: 100 / users).
